entries.title: See a saved Codex reset when your allowance runs out
entries.body: When ChatGPT gives your Codex account saved resets, its Subscriptions row says how many it holds. When the allowance runs out and a saved reset would refill it now, the card says so and links to ChatGPT's usage page, where you use it.

picture.alt: The first mate's used-up allowance card saying Codex · Work has a saved reset you can use now, with a link to the usage page on chatgpt.com above the Open settings and Recheck allowance buttons
